title: DELIVERANCE IN
THE MIDNIGHT HOUR
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: silhouette of watchtower against midnight sky
ancient candle flickering in stone sanctuary
soft moonlight on empty stone floor
glowing stars over silhouette mountain range
shadowy prayer corner with dim lamp

scenes.a: The heavy burden you carry in silence right now finds its rest at this hour.
Hear these sacred words meant to anchor your spirit against the rising dark of night.
And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Lord, in this still moment, we release our anxieties and trust in your sovereign protection.
Grant us the quiet confidence that your grace covers every hidden fear we face today.
We stand firm in your promise and remain hopeful under your eternal and watchful care.
